scope: Official admin A-to-C transfer of a REPORT_APPROVAL dual-provider order, followed by three actual recipient credits and cumulative partial/full refunds

findings_and_fixes.issue: Transfer locked the outgoing wallet before updating/locking outgoing provider profile, reversing the profile-to-wallet order of another order refund or a cash-deposit refund
findings_and_fixes.fix: After locking Order, join existing OrderFinancialLock before any funds/profile lock; lock the full old/new provider profile set by user_id before any wallet; retain dispatch-capacity locks and existing rules
findings_and_fixes.evidence: Actual MySQL event-gated refund and official cash-deposit-refund tests establish that transfer does not enter its old-wallet lock while the other transaction owns its profile; all six new races pass

findings_and_fixes.issue: A DOUBLE batch could transfer both outgoing providers to the same new account, leaving one active seat and blocking the two-participant fulfillment flow
findings_and_fixes.fix: Validate the resulting active distinct-account set against purchased two-person team size before financial effects; reject atomically; preserve historical SINGLE merge behavior
findings_and_fixes.evidence: Original endpoint returned code 0 for the invalid merge before the fix; the final isolated regression requires code 400 and unchanged database snapshots

findings_and_fixes.issue: Transfer order update was emitted before a possible enclosing transaction committed
findings_and_fixes.fix: Register notify_order_update with transaction.on_commit; rollback discards it
findings_and_fixes.evidence: Successful outer commit publishes once; outer rollback produces no order event and preserves original assignment

released_participant_audit.required_report_providers: Positive retained settlement_base keeps released A required; zero retained A is not required or paid
released_participant_audit.settlement: No income is posted at REPORT_APPROVAL transfer time; all required three reports must pass before settlement
released_participant_audit.refund_plan: All successful original credits are included regardless of released_at; recovery follows cumulative original credit weights
released_participant_audit.ordinary_orders: Released A remains visible through full OrderProvider association in list and detail
released_participant_audit.notifier: Released A, retained B and incoming C receive separately scoped full payloads with their own expected_income and refund_summary

official_fixture_path: Independent paid IN_SERVICE DOUBLE fixture built with build_provider_shares and aggregate_order_split
Only fixture completed_at changed to mature the completion-based 72-hour settlement window
All required A/B/C owners upload ENTRY, COMPLETION and RESULT through report image API and submit officially

GET refund-preview then POST refund with amount, plan_token and client_request_id
Official withdrawal creation/rejection and release_due_income are used only inside isolated test DB

financial_assertions.case: Outgoing A and incoming C each independently lack sufficient available funds after a pending withdrawal
Final successful replay and conflicting intent

outgoing A hold release versus partial refund

initial_runs.fixture_correction: New Order.save snapshots the current global hold rule; the independent fixture now explicitly restores its intended per-order 72-hour snapshot after creation. This was a test-fixture correction, not a production hold defect.

review.final_independent_read_only_review: PASS; no required issues. Confirmed Order -> funds mutex -> sorted profiles -> wallets order, immutable two-person team guard, historical SINGLE compatibility and on-commit notification.

limitations: Only REPORT_APPROVAL transferred settled partial refunds are covered by the new financial scenarios. Historical COMPLETION transfer timing remains unchanged and its existing ReleaseFlow regression passes.
These are isolated backend tests; the parent agent runs the separately tagged local multi-client integration.
